name: Amazon Shopping
description: Search products, add to cart, place orders, and track deliveries on Amazon.in
author: flock

requires.description: Log in to Amazon.in via the dashboard browser session to access shopping and orders
requires.rationale: Amazon has no public shopping API — a saved browser session is how the agent shops on your behalf.

read-products.reason: Searches, then opens up to 13 product pages in rounds of 5 tabs (and a variant's own page when the result is another size) and reads each in the page: 30-90s. Killed at 30s, the agent would get no cards and read the pages by hand.

read-variants.reason: Opens every colour and size's own page (up to 40), 5 tabs at a time, and reads each: 1-3 minutes. The owner asked for it on the card's button and is told it takes a minute or two.

networkEndpoints.purpose: Amazon.in product search and product pages
